q: How long does shipping take?
a: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days within the country. Express shipping arrives in 1–2 business days. Orders placed before 2 pm ship the same day.

q: How much does shipping cost?
a: Standard shipping is $4.95, and free on orders over $50. Express shipping is $12.95 for any order.

q: Do you ship internationally?
a: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery takes 7–14 business days, and the cost is shown at checkout once you enter your address.

q: Who pays customs duties and import taxes?
a: For international orders, any customs duties or import taxes are charged by the destination country and paid by the recipient on delivery. We can't predict or refund them.

q: How can I track my order?
a: Once your order ships we email you a tracking link. You can also see it under Orders in your account.

q: My tracking hasn't updated in days. What should I do?
a: Tracking can pause for a few days while a parcel moves between carriers. If it hasn't changed in 7 business days, contact us and we'll open an investigation with the carrier.

q: My package says delivered but I didn't get it.
a: Check with neighbours and around your property, and wait one more day: carriers sometimes mark parcels delivered early. If it still hasn't arrived, contact us within 14 days and we'll send a replacement or refund.

q: Can I change or cancel my order?
a: You can change or cancel an order within one hour of placing it, from Orders in your account. After that it may already be packed; contact us and we'll do what we can.

q: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
a: Yes, if the order hasn't shipped yet. Edit the address under Orders in your account, or contact us. Once it has shipped we can't redirect it.

q: What is your return policy?
a: You can return unused items in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Sale items can be returned for store credit only.

q: How do I return an item?
a: Start a return under Orders in your account, choose the items, and print the prepaid label we email you. Drop the parcel at any post office.

q: Are returns free?
a: Returns are free within the country with our prepaid label. For international returns, you pay the postage back to us.

q: When will I get my refund?
a: We refund you within 3 business days of receiving your return. Your bank may take another 5–10 days to show it on your statement.

q: Can I exchange an item for a different size or colour?
a: Yes. Start a return and choose Exchange instead of Refund, then pick the new size or colour. We ship the replacement as soon as the original is scanned by the carrier.

q: My item arrived damaged or broken.
a: Sorry about that! Send us a photo of the damage and your order number within 14 days of delivery, and we'll send a replacement or a full refund. You don't need to return the damaged item.

q: I received the wrong item.
a: Contact us with your order number and a photo of what arrived. We'll send the right item straight away and email you a prepaid label for the wrong one.

q: What payment methods do you accept?
a: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay, as well as our own gift cards.

q: Can I pay in instalments?
a: Yes, on orders over $35 you can choose Klarna at checkout to pay in four interest-free instalments.

q: Why was my payment declined?
a: Payments are usually declined because the billing address doesn't match your card, the card has expired, or your bank blocked the charge. Check your details or try another payment method. We never see your card number.

q: Is it safe to use my credit card on your site?
a: Yes. Payments are processed by our payment provider over an encrypted connection, and we never store your card details on our servers.

q: Do you charge sales tax?
a: Sales tax is added at checkout based on your delivery address, as required by local law.

q: Can I get an invoice or receipt for my order?
a: A receipt is emailed when you order. You can also download a PDF invoice from Orders in your account, and add a company name and tax number to it.

q: How do I use a discount code?
a: Enter the code in the Discount code box at checkout and press Apply. Only one code can be used per order.

q: My discount code isn't working.
a: Check that the code hasn't expired, that your order meets its minimum spend, and that it's typed exactly as given. Codes don't apply to gift cards or items already on sale.

q: Do you offer student or military discounts?
a: Yes, students and members of the armed forces get 15% off. Verify your status through the Discounts page and we'll email you a code.

q: Do you sell gift cards?
a: Yes, digital gift cards from $10 to $500 are emailed straight away, with a personal message if you like. They never expire.

q: How do I check my gift card balance?
a: Enter your gift card number on the Gift Cards page to see its balance, or apply it at checkout and the remaining balance is shown.

q: How do I create an account?
a: Click Sign in at the top of the page and choose Create account. You only need your email address and a password.

q: Can I order without an account?
a: Yes, you can check out as a guest. You'll still get order and tracking emails; creating an account later links your past orders by email.

q: I forgot my password.
a: Click Sign in, then Forgot password, and enter your email. We'll send you a link to set a new password; it's valid for one hour.

q: How do I change my email address or details?
a: Sign in and go to Account settings, where you can change your name, email, password and saved addresses.

q: How do I delete my account?
a: Go to Account settings and choose Delete account at the bottom of the page. We remove your personal data within 30 days, except what we must keep for tax records.

q: How do I unsubscribe from your emails?
a: Click Unsubscribe at the bottom of any of our emails, or turn off marketing emails in Account settings. You'll still get emails about your orders.

q: What do you do with my personal data?
a: We use your data only to process orders and, if you agree, to send offers. We never sell it. Our Privacy Policy has the details, and you can ask for a copy of your data at any time.

q: How can I contact customer service?
a: Use the chat button at the bottom right, email help@example.com, or call 1-800-555-0199. We reply within one business day.

q: What are your customer service hours?
a: Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, and Saturday, 10 am to 4 pm (Eastern time). We're closed on public holidays.

q: Do you have a physical store?
a: We're online only, so we can keep our prices low. You can pick up orders from our warehouse by choosing Local pickup at checkout.

q: How do I find my size?
a: Every product page has a Size guide link with measurements in inches and centimetres. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up.

q: Will an out-of-stock item be restocked?
a: Most items are restocked within 2–4 weeks. Click Notify me on the product page and we'll email you when it's back.

q: Do you price match?
a: We don't match other retailers' prices, but if an item you bought goes on sale with us within 14 days, we'll refund the difference.

q: Is there a warranty on your products?
a: All products have a one-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Contact us with your order number and a photo, and we'll repair or replace the item.

q: How do I care for and wash my clothes?
a: Care instructions are on each product's label and page. Most items should be washed cold and hung to dry to keep their shape and colour.

q: Are your products sustainable?
a: Our clothes are made from organic cotton and recycled materials, in factories we audit every year. All packaging is plastic-free and recyclable.

q: Do you offer gift wrapping?
a: Yes, choose Gift wrap at checkout for $3.50. We can include a handwritten note and leave prices off the packing slip.

q: Do you offer wholesale or bulk discounts?
a: Yes, for orders of 50 items or more. Email wholesale@example.com with what you need and we'll send a quote.
